title: Piglin Bartering
blurb: Every item obtainable by bartering gold ingots with piglins, with its probability, quantity, and average yield.
note: Piglin bartering loot table (loot_table/gameplay/piglin_bartering.json). 18 items from 19 producers. minecraft:potion carries two bartering producers (2.132% and 1.706% for normal and splash potions of fire resistance) which merge into one row at 3.838% with quantity 1 because potion variants are not distinguished in the obtain graph. Icon borrowed from Gold Ingot.
